text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council amended the Public Appointments process to authorize the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the North Toronto Memorial Arena Board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed Blair Robinson as the stakeholder representative for the North Toronto Hockey Association to the North Toronto Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on September 16, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.
